about_the_game:
Tanks: 1985 is a modern reimagining of the legendary Battle City tank game — built for both nostalgic players and new fans.
Blast through enemies, protect your eagle, and enjoy exciting new features that bring the retro arcade experience to life!

🕹️ Game Features

  • 37 Classic Levels – Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

⚡ New Twists on a Classic

  • Powerup Wheel – Spend coins mid-battle to activate shields, speed boosts, and more!

💥 Why Tanks: 1985?

  • Nostalgic retro graphics with pixel-perfect style.

  • Modern quality-of-life features (matchmaking, achievements, Steam integration).

  • A thriving community where creativity (map editor) meets competition.

  • 👉 Whether you’re defending the eagle solo, teaming up with friends, or showing off your custom maps, Tanks: 1985 delivers a perfect blend of retro action and modern multiplayer fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8, Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better (any GPU with DirectX 10 support)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Classic tank battles reborn with online play, powerups, emojis & map editor!
